description: Delegate the subdomain to your own nameservers, handing you full control of it and everything beneath it (your own records, MX, deeper sub-domains). AgentDomains stops answering for the name, so its existing records, forwards, and proxies no longer apply. Supply at least two nameservers.

domain.description: Which domain to act under: 'makes.fyi' (the default) or 'agentdomains.co'. The same label can exist under each, so pass this whenever you are not using the default.

label.description: The subdomain label, without the domain suffix (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.makes.fyi).

nameservers.description: Your nameserver hostnames, e.g. ['ns1.yourdns.com', 'ns2.yourdns.com']. At least two.

name: delegate_nameservers
